hero.title: Money In. Money Out. One Truth.
hero.description: Receivables from your accounting platform, operational expenses from HABOS, voice-captured costs from the field — all reconciled in one dashboard.

body: The Finance module provides a unified view of all money flowing through the business. Receivables sync from your accounting platform with invoice status tracking — draft, sent, partially paid, paid, overdue. Expenses are captured by voice: say 'spent $45 on tile adhesive at the hardware store' and the Smart Router creates an expense record with merchant, amount, and project allocation. Monthly revenue snapshots rebuild automatically for cash flow visibility.
dashboardCaption: Receivables sync from your accounting platform. Expenses captured by voice, receipt, or manual entry. Monthly revenue snapshots rebuild automatically.

benefits.title: Voice expense capture
benefits.desc: Say "spent $180 on tile at Home Depot" while driving. HABOS creates the expense, auto-matches the merchant, and suggests the account code.

benefits.title: Invoice automation
benefits.desc: Turn HABOS orders and time entries into accounting invoices. Smart entity resolution maps CRM clients to accounting contacts automatically.

benefits.title: Monthly snapshots
benefits.desc: Invoiced, received, outstanding, and overdue totals rebuild monthly. See cash flow trends without a spreadsheet.

scenario: End of month. Your accountant asks: "What's the outstanding balance and which clients are overdue?" Instead of exporting from 3 systems and cross-referencing in Excel — you open HABOS Finance. $9,150 outstanding, $2,300 overdue from Wilson Plumbing (14 days). One screen, real numbers from your accounting platform, zero reconciliation.

cta.heading: Other dashboards show estimates. HABOS shows accounting truth.
